title: Recover the genuine generator recipe for signal_tower_concept_sheet_v1

hash_comparison.method: sha256 of every recipe/workflow-shaped file committed under assets/src/concept/, plus every other committed ComfyUI-workflow-shaped JSON found elsewhere in assets/src/, checked against the provenance's recorded workflow_hash. Also grepped the literal hash string repo-wide.

candidates_checked.note: pre-existing file, plausible fields (same prompt/seed/steps/cfg/checkpoint as the provenance record) but its own hash does not match workflow_hash -- exactly the 'looks plausible but proves nothing' edge case the card called out
graph's own filename_prefix is player_character_concept_sheet_v1 -- belongs to a different sheet, not signal_tower

hash_comparison.repo_wide_grep: the literal string 17641e4c4d422d796f56571502bbb2663517a7efa4a981768bd5c08eac6e7b63 was grepped across the whole repository tree (every worktree checkout); it only ever appears as the recorded workflow_hash value inside signal_tower_concept_sheet_v1.provenance.json itself -- never as a value or filename anywhere else
hash_comparison.conclusion: no committed file's sha256 matches workflow_hash

comfyui_history_lookup.full_history_check: GET /history (no id) currently returns exactly 1 entry total, and it is unrelated to this prompt_id
comfyui_history_lookup.conclusion: prompt_id has aged out of ComfyUI history -- this is an older T-0104-era sheet and the host has cycled through many later runs since; no live payload survives to compare against

decision: Escalate rather than fabricate, per this card's own integrity rule. assets/src/concept/signal_tower_concept_sheet_v1.provenance.json is left with no `generator` field, and its generator_baseline.txt exemption is left in place -- it is the one remaining src/concept baseline entry T-0236 could not close on merit.
what_would_resolve_this: A human with access to the original generation session's history/logs (or a Windows-host ComfyUI output-folder backup carrying the embedded PNG workflow metadata for this specific run) could recover the real workflow JSON and let it be verified and committed.

If genuinely unrecoverable, the likely correct remediation is the T-0221/T-0226 pattern: regenerate the sheet for real through a committed pipeline (new prompt_id, new workflow_hash, new recipe committed alongside) rather than reconstructing a paper trail for a run that can no longer be verified.
